boundaries: This runbook is CLI/report product surface only.
Manual live-local commands require explicit operator opt-in.
Raw outputs remain local and ignored until reviewed normalization approves public-safe evidence.
The hosted provider path is deferred and separated from local/open-weight rankings.
No public leaderboard, production-safety proof, third-party reproducibility claim, or private-audit overclaim is made.

excluded_targets.reason: Cloud-labelled target must not support local/open-weight claims.

primary_local_targets.reason: Installed local/open-weight target for reviewed extended evidence.
Installed local/open-weight target for reviewed extended evidence.

smoke_control_targets.reason: Use for quick operator smoke checks only; smoke-only evidence cannot unlock rankings.

objective: Run reviewed extended local_public_v1 evidence for at least two installed local Ollama models, then unlock the local/open-weight benchmark report only after ledger and review gates pass.

operator_commands.label: Plan gemma4 extended run
operator_commands.notes: Plan-only command is safe for operator review and does not call the local model.

operator_commands.command: AGENT_EVALS_ENABLE_LIVE_LOCAL=1 python3 scripts/live_local.py --model gemma4:latest --adapter ollama_text_only --split extended --live-local
operator_commands.label: Execute gemma4 extended run
operator_commands.notes: Manual opt-in only; raw outputs must remain under ignored local paths until reviewed.

operator_commands.command: AGENT_EVALS_ENABLE_LIVE_LOCAL=1 python3 scripts/live_local.py --model llama3.2:latest --adapter ollama_text_only --split extended --live-local
operator_commands.label: Execute llama3.2 extended run
operator_commands.notes: Manual opt-in only; needed as the second eligible model before local rankings can publish.

operator_commands.label: Normalize reviewed outputs
operator_commands.notes: Only reviewed, public-safe normalized outputs may move into committed evidence paths.

operator_commands.label: Validate ledger and regenerate report
operator_commands.notes: Publication remains blocked until two eligible reviewed extended ledgers exist with no unresolved review.

publication_gate.blocked_reason: No reviewed live-local extended ledgers exist for the two primary local targets yet.
unlock_requirements: Run the extended split for gemma4:latest and llama3.2:latest with explicit live-local opt-in.
Keep raw outputs local and ignored until review approves public-safe normalized outputs.
Review every failed case, every high or critical case, and the deterministic pass sample.
Build ledgers with local_public_benchmark evidence class and no unresolved review, unsafe output, malformed output, private data, or raw outputs.
Regenerate the local/open-weight benchmark report after at least two eligible reviewed ledgers exist.
